description: This Java source file defines the PrefsXmlStorage class, which handles serialization and deserialization of preferences data for the AnySoftKeyboard app. It includes methods for storing preferences to XML and loading preferences from XML, utilizing SAX parser for reading XML and a custom XmlWriter for writing XML. The class manages preference items and their hierarchical structure, supporting versioning and flexible XML node handling.

classes.name: PrefsXmlStorage
classes.description: Main class responsible for storing and loading preferences in XML format.

classes.name: PrefsXmlParser
classes.description: Inner class extending DefaultHandler to parse preferences XML and build preference objects.

methods.name: writePrefItems
methods.description: Recursively writes preference items and their children to XML using XmlWriter.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Serializes the preferences root object to an XML output stream.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads preferences from an input stream containing XML data, returning a PrefsRoot object.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, creating preference nodes accordingly.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element during parsing, managing the node stack.

methods.name: getParsedRoot
methods.description: Returns the parsed preferences root after XML parsing.
